en.hubeali: A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad and Yaqoub Bin Yazeed, from Muhammad Bin Dazawayi who said,
‘I wrote to Abu Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup>, asking him<sup>asws</sup> about the wine drinker. So he<sup>asws</sup> wrote: ‘The wine drinker is an Infidel’.
en.sarwar: 9. A number of our people have narrated from Sahl ibn Ziyad and Ya’qub ibn Yazid from Muhammad ibn Dadhawayh who has said the following:
“I once wrote to abu al-Hassan, asking him (the Imam) about drinking intoxicating liquor. He (the Imam) wrote back in answer, ‘A wine drinker is an unbeliever.’”
